_comment: Pi provider definition for the local H200 endpoint.
Copy to ~/.pi/agent/models.json (see pi.dev docs: models.md) or point
PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR at a directory containing it. `apiKey` may interpolate
the environment ($NAME / ${NAME}), and a dummy value is fine for vLLM.
The `local` provider name is what `--provider local --model <id>` selects in
benchmarks/agents/pi.py; set options.provider to change it.
'api': 'openai-completions' is the OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions surface
